display_title: The Loser Is the First Lady
description:
Korea’s most infamous power couple—now running against each other for president. One’s conservative, the other progressive. One’s an early riser, the other a night owl. They fight over everything—from house chores to national policy. And unfortunately for the nation… they’re both members of the National Assembly. But when a major political scandal explodes right before the presidential election, they both decide to run. Against each other. “Let’s settle this in front of the entire country. Winner gets the Blue House. Loser? Enjoy being First Spouse.” A satirical, high-stakes political rom-com of love, rivalry, and democracy. Let the 21st presidential election begin.

(Source: Naver, translated)
